outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± s.d. of cell death (%) across three independent experiments (Trypan blue exclusion), but only the mean and error bars are shown; no individual data points (e.g., from the three replicate experiments) are overlaid on the bars.

Panel B is a bar chart of cell death (%) presumably averaged across replicate experiments, but only bars (no error bars mentioned, and no individual data points) are shown, so the underlying replicate values are not visible.

Panel C is a grouped bar chart showing mean ± s.d. of cell death (%) across three independent experiments at different time points, but individual data points from the three experiments are not overlaid on the bars.
Panel D is a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars, but no individual data points are shown overlaid on the bars to reveal the underlying replicate values.
